site: UPSC Zen
url: https://upsc.zenscroll.app
type: educational web application
focus: UPSC CSE Prelims preparation through PYQ-first learning

primary intention:
  - Help aspirants decode UPSC PYQ patterns (2020-2025) and improve exam reasoning.
  - Prioritize PYQ Intelligence over generic content browsing.
  - Provide structured, expert-style explanations for each PYQ.

pyq intelligence 4-point framework:
  - Conceptual Core: the core concept and quick verdict behind the correct option.
  - Core Pillar: the foundational principle that anchors the concept.
  - Logic Path: stepwise reasoning to reach the right answer.
  - Trap Watch: common UPSC traps and elimination cautions.
